description: Capability for the Picus (SQL studio) product shell — its dedicated window, and the tabbed container that can host it as a tab. `allow-destroy` is here because Picus listens for the close request (to ask about an open transaction before the window goes) and Tauri's own `onCloseRequested` ends with `destroy()` whenever the listener did not prevent the default — so every close of this window, including the ordinary one with nothing to ask, goes through that command. Without it the window refuses to close at all.
